applications.name: I'm Not Your Punching Bag Anymore
applications.description:
[eb1212]Winter Soldier has had enough, and unshackled himself from previous abilities.[-] In this fight:

•The Attacker gains [f8c11b]1 Hostility Charge[-] when Winter Soldier is struck with the first hit of any Basic Attack, and [f8c11b]4[-] per level of an activated Special.
•At [f8c11b]150 Charges[-], Winter Soldier is Wounded, takes 2,500% more damage, and cannot gain Power for 25 seconds.
•When Wounded expires, and at the start of each fight starting in Phase 2, he gains 7 indefinite +7.50% [k=glossary/prowess]Prowess[/k] Passives.
•[k=glossary/intercept]Intercepting[/k] Winter Soldier transfers one Prowess to the Attacker and Passively Regenerates them 7.50% Health. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

Winter Soldier prevents the Attacker’s Regeneration Rate from increasing, he cannot Miss or use Special 1, and during his Special 2 he prevents the Attacker from healing.

applications.name: Acts Of Peace
applications.description:
[52aa17]Winter Soldier is amenable to Peace.[-] In this fight:

•After his Special 2, he offers the Attacker a choice of [52aa17]Peace[-] by Dodging back, or [f8c11b]Violence[-] by Dashing forward.
•Dashing forward and [f8c11b]Choosing Violence[-] grants the Attacker [f8c11b]25 Hostility Charges[-] and Winter Soldier 1 indefinite 15% [k=glossary/energize]Energize[/k] Passive. Max stacks: 3.
•Dodging back and [52aa17]Choosing Peace[-] removes 1 of Winter Soldier’s Energizes and heals [52aa17]85% of the damage[-] that the Special dealt into Block over 1.3 seconds or until Winter Soldier is struck.
•If Winter Soldier has 3 Energizes, his Special 2 deals 5% of the Attackers Max Health per hit. This cannot be Blocked, prevented, or reduced in any way and consumes all Energizes.

applications.name: Phases of Combat
applications.description:
Each Phase has a cumulative [k=glossary/reversal][bc22c6]Reversal[-][/k] trigger. When a Reversal triggers, Winter Soldier gains an Energize.

•Phase 1: [eb1212]You're The Punching Bag Now.[-] New Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Light [k=glossary/combo_enders][bc22c6]Combo-Enders[-][/k][-].
•Phase 2: At 75% Health, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Medium [k=glossary/combo_enders][bc22c6]Combo-Enders[-][/k][-].
•Phase 3: At 40%, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Striking a Stunned Winter Soldier with a Basic Attack[-].
•Phase 4: At 1%, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Hitting Winter Soldier’s Block[-]. Additionally, the Attacker must [52aa17]Choose Peace[-] 3 times to remove [k=glossary/cross_fight_ability_winter_soldier]Cross-Fight[/k] Indestructible Passives and then defeat Winter Soldier with a Special 2.

Each Phase transition gives Winter Soldier [k=glossary/intimidate]Intimidate[/k] and [k=glossary/indestructible]Indestructible[/k] Passives for 5 seconds, removes all his Wounded and Energizes, and resets his Power and all [f8c11b]Hostility Charges[-].

applications.name: Higher, Further, Faster
applications.description:
The Defender gains 5% of Max Power each time their Block is hit.

The Defender gains 1 Binary Charge every 0.4 seconds, and 5 every time the Attacker Blocks a hit. At 99, they trigger Ignition for 20 seconds, paused during the Defender’s Heavy Attacks. Charges cannot be gained until Ignition ends.

Ignition grants Stun Immunity and a 100% chance to Auto-Block Light and Medium Attacks. Additionally, Special Attacks cost 75% less Power and cannot be avoided with the Dexterity Mastery. If the Defender’s Specials are Well-Timed Blocked, the Attacker gains 5% of missing Power and a 50% Vigor Passive for 10 seconds, paused while Ignition is still active. These Vigors cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy and cannot expire during the Attacker’s Specials

If the Defender reaches {3} Charges they become Passively [k=glossary/unblockable]Unblockable[/k] and [k=glossary/unstoppable]Unstoppable[/k], and more aggressive for {2} seconds.
